newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Merged Westpac, Trust Bank to shed 105 posts.
newsitem.headline: Merged Westpac, Trust Bank to shed 105 posts.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Thursday 105 management positions will disappear over the next 18 months from the merger of the retail operations of Westpac and Trust Bank.
The exact number of redundancies could not be estimated because of the impact of redeployment opportunities and natural attrition, chief executive of the combined banks, Harry Price said.
Westpac bought Trust Bank in June after an on-market offer valuing the bank at $1.27 billion.
Under the new structure Price will lead a team of 12 senior managers at the bank's Wellington-based head office.
Four new regional general manager positions will be based in Auckland, Hamilton, Wellington and Christchurch.
Each general manager will oversee 20 branch area managers and eight commercial area managers with responsibility for directly managing the retail networks.
In addition, because of the size of the southern region, an Otago/Southland regional manager will be based in Dunedin, supported by an administrative/sponsorship officer and a money market manager.
On Tuesday, Westpac announced the membership of the advisory board which will oversee operations of Westpac New Zealand and Trust Bank after they merge.
The board includes four directors from Trust Bank, including its managing director Graeme Pentecost. The other four members are drawn from the Westpac camp.
